title: Shader samples a combined image sampler at set 0 binding 1 that the pipeline layout does not declare
fix_note: no upstream fix (issue gives only the validation message); the fixed variant declares and writes the combined image sampler at set 0 binding 1, as VUID-VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo-layout-00756 requires
expected_finding: fsMain statically uses u_BaseColorSampler (COMBINED_IMAGE_SAMPLER, set 0 binding 1), but echo_material_pipeline's layout declares only binding 0 (uniform buffer) in set 0 (VUID-VkGraphicsPipelineCreateInfo-layout-00756: descriptor slot 0.1 not declared in pipeline layout)
